miei.jei.info.matter: Place in a Modern Industrialization multiblock to give it access to Replication matter. Input hatches feed matter to recipes that need it; output hatches collect matter a recipe produces. Connect them to a Replication network with matter pipes.
miei.jei.info.stress: Place in a Modern Industrialization multiblock, then attach a Kinetic Coupler to its exposed face and drive that with a Create shaft. Recipes asking for stress units will load the rotational network while they run.
miei.jei.info.coupler: Attach to the exposed face of a Stress Input Hatch and drive the opposite face with a shaft. While the multiblock runs a recipe that needs stress units, this applies that load to the Create network.
miei.jei.info.air: Place in a Modern Industrialization multiblock to give it access to compressed air. Connect it to a PneumaticCraft compressor with pressure tubes. Recipes can require a minimum pressure and consume air when they start.
miei.jei.info.heat: Place in a Modern Industrialization multiblock to give it a PneumaticCraft heat exchanger. Heat it or cool it with any PneumaticCraft heat source. Recipes can require a temperature range and draw heat as they craft.
miei.jei.info.chemical: Place in a Modern Industrialization multiblock to give it access to Mekanism chemicals, covering gases, infusions, pigments and slurries. Input hatches feed recipes; output hatches collect what a recipe produces. Connect them with pressurised tubes.
miei.jade.secured: Security Upgrade: vents when over pressure
miei.jade.unsecured: No Security Upgrade: ruptures when over pressure
